metadata.description: The /dec, /judge, /retro and /repo-audit slash commands (declarative reframing + contract-anchored acceptance + stalled-loop retro + repo audit, pair with /goal) — Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) localization

plugins.name: saygoal
plugins.description: Four slash commands: /dec reframes an imperative request as a contract (success criteria + verification command + boundaries incl. the verification surface + a ready-to-use /goal condition); /judge accepts claimed-done work against that contract — treats the report as a set of claims, re-runs the verification itself, audits the diff against the verification surface, hunts weakened tests and false completion claims, and returns VERIFIED / VERIFIED WITH CAVEATS / REFUTED; /retro post-mortems a stalled /goal loop — reads the transcript as a search trace, diagnoses the stall, and structurally rewrites the contract with a rollback line; /repo-audit runs a principal-level read-only repo audit whose task plan ends each task with a ready-to-paste /goal condition. All pair with Claude Code's built-in /goal (v2.1.139+) to form the user-side leverage pipeline Karpathy described. Includes a CLAUDE.md you can adopt separately via README install options. Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) localization fork of forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills.
